name: control-surface-sy181-15k3e-2.0.2
attribution: Fork of EpicLPer's CH552-OpenMacroPad, on Stefan Wagner's (wagiminator) CH55x USB HID code
flash: wchisp flash <file> (ROM bootloader 4348:55e0; config registers untouched)
notes: Built reproducibly, host-tested (fw_logic including a 10 s run over ~39 wraps of the 8-bit millisecond clock, fw_store, fw_asmcheck) and verified on hardware in both input modes.

hardwareVerification.flashMethod: CMD_BOOTLOADER from 2.0.1 (no key hold), wchisp Verify OK (2026-10-07 22:58)
hardwareVerification.rawCheck: padctl.py rawcheck: 495 samples over 6 s under 500 ms heartbeats, raw off 0, unanswered commands 0, raw mode ended 1.51 s after the last heartbeat
hardwareVerification.stressTest: scripts/stress-test.py --mode both with the user at the pad: 59/59 checks, 0 warnings, 0 failures (evdev 27, raw 32)
hardwareVerification.details: In both modes: taps of all 15 keys in order, holds of 0.1/0.3/1/2/3/4/5 s, key1 held while key2 and key8 are tapped, knob presses x3; per knob slow turns, fast back-and-forth spins and flicks where the host's detent counts matched the firmware's decoder counts exactly (raw, knob1: slow 20/21, fast cw 75 ccw 71, flick 25; knob2: 20/20, 85/81, 24; knob3: 20/20, 79/72, 22). Raw mode: mode flips 0, raw drops 0, heartbeat misses 0, keymap input while raw 0, expiries on the pad 0, sequence gaps 0, nothing restored.
